description: This file contains utility functions and types for managing namespace deletion status conditions in Kubernetes, including error handling, condition updates, and status reporting.

classes.name: namespaceConditionUpdater
classes.description: Implements NamespaceConditionUpdater interface to manage namespace deletion conditions.

methods.name: ProcessGroupVersionErr
methods.description: Creates a condition indicating failure to parse group version.

methods.name: ProcessDiscoverResourcesErr
methods.description: Creates a condition indicating failure to discover resource groups.

methods.name: ProcessContentTotals
methods.description: Generates conditions based on remaining resources and finalizers.

methods.name: ProcessDeleteContentErr
methods.description: Records errors encountered during resource deletion.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates namespace status conditions based on recorded errors and states.
